data.description:
## The gap

AGENTS.md's 'Navigating the codebase' table tells agents:

  | who calls / imports a symbol | Serena find_referencing_symbols — semantic, no comment false positives |

It documents grep's weakness (a symbol named as a STRING — monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib)
but not Serena's. There is a third failure mode, and it is the more dangerous shape because it
returns a confident EMPTY RESULT rather than an obvious error.

## Demonstrated, not theorised

`set_entity_property` has three real call sites in the reconciler core:
`dispatch_one.py:321`, `binding_store.py:517`, `apply_inbound_records.py:279`.

    find_referencing_symbols('AcliRestMixin/set_entity_property',
                             'adapters/jira/acli_rest.py')  ->  {}

Zero references. For the method whose absence on the DC transport CRASHED a live reconcile pass
(epic e369, [rebar:a357-b747-ece9-4cf5]).

Cause: the reconciler passes the transport around as an UNANNOTATED parameter —
`def _update_one_apply_reporter(fields, issue_key, client) -> None`,
`def _update_one_apply_parent(fields, issue_key, client) -> bool`, and so on. `client` is an
implicit `Any`, so Pyright cannot resolve `client.set_entity_property` to any definition and the
LSP correctly reports no references.

CONTROL, so this is not 'Serena is broken': `find_referencing_symbols('TicketTransport',
'_backend.py')` correctly returns its one reference (`Backend.transport`'s return annotation).
Serena is precise wherever types exist. It is blind exactly where this reconciler is duck-typed —
which is most of the transport surface.

## Why it matters beyond one method

An agent following the table would ask Serena 'who calls set_entity_property?', get `{}`, and
reasonably conclude the method is unused — the exact opposite of the truth. A grep for
`set_entity_property` finds all three sites instantly. The documented division of labour inverts
here.

## Proposed change

Add a third row / caveat to the AGENTS.md table and to docs/code-navigation.md:

  | a method reached through an UNTYPED receiver (`client`, `transport`, `**kwargs` plumbing) |
    grep — the LSP cannot infer the receiver type, so Serena returns a FALSE EMPTY, not an error |

and state the general rule: **an empty Serena result is only meaningful when the receiver is typed.**
When it returns nothing for a symbol you believe is used, confirm with grep before concluding.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AGENTS.md's navigation table names the untyped-receiver failure mode alongside the
      symbol-as-string one
- [ ] docs/code-navigation.md carries the reproduction above (the set_entity_property empty result +
      the TicketTransport control) so the claim is evidenced, matching how that doc already evidences
      the epic 061c S1 failure
- [ ] the guidance states the asymmetry explicitly: a NON-empty Serena result is trustworthy; an EMPTY
      one is not, unless the receiver is typed
data.title: AGENTS.md navigation guidance: Serena returns a FALSE EMPTY for untyped duck-typed receivers
